title: codopex: Symmetry-inequivalent co-doping defect-complex generation
description: Generation of symmetry-inequivalent co-doping defect pairs and higher-order defect complexes in a host supercell using pymatgen/spglib symmetry analysis, with POSCAR export, JSON persistence and a command-line interface. The repository also ships an agent skill that guides users through the physically guided co-doping workflow of the accompanying paper.
